title: Full Stack Developer (Intern)
description:
Spredo is a leading AI-based platform for automating B2B outreach on Telegram.

Our clients include industry leaders in Web3 and iGaming, such as Hacken, CoinTelegraph, ChainGPT, and others.

Tech Stack
Must Have: Python, React, Docker.
Nice To Have: Claude Code, AI Agents Orchestration

Responsibilities
Maintain the platform and resolve bugs promptly to ensure smooth operation for clients
Continuously brainstorm and implement new features
Communicate directly with clients via Telegram groups to answer technical questions and address reported issues
Collaborate closely with the Founder and Technical Advisor via Slack, daily syncs, and monthly team calls
Write documentation and shadow a senior full-stack developer
Actively leverage tools such as Claude Max to improve development efficiency

Growth Opportunities
Clear path for growth within the team
Compensation increases based on performance
Semi-annual performance reviews and adjustments

Work Format
Fully remote position
Flexible working hours (~30hr/week)
Work on the weekends is fine
Designed for university students currently undergoing their studies
